_comment: Pictures shown under the films. t = when the picture starts showing (main and cwt: year; c228: day number, 0 = Feb 27, 1 = Feb 28, 2 = Mar 1 ...). file = exact file name on Wikimedia Commons. After editing run python tools/fetch_images.py.

main.zh: 歐洲人筆下的福爾摩沙人。達波（Olfert Dapper）1670 年著作中的銅版畫，畫的是想像多於寫實。
main.en: Formosans as Europeans imagined them: an engraving from Olfert Dapper’s book of 1670.

main.zh: 熱蘭遮城與大員市鎮，芬伯翁斯（Johannes Vingboons）約 1635 年繪。
main.en: Fort Zeelandia and the town of Tayouan, painted by Johannes Vingboons about 1635.

main.zh: 荷蘭人向鄭成功投降。1675 年荷蘭出版品中的版畫，出自當時歐洲人的想像。
main.en: The Dutch surrender to Koxinga, an engraving from a Dutch book of 1675, drawn as Europeans imagined the scene.

main.zh: 《康熙臺灣輿圖》局部，約 1700 年前後繪製，畫出村社、河流與山。
main.en: A detail of the Kangxi Map of Taiwan, drawn around 1700, showing villages, rivers and hills.

main.zh: 平埔族人捕鹿。清代巡台御史六十七約 1740 年代命人繪製的《番社采風圖》。
main.en: Plains Indigenous hunters chasing deer, from an album of village life painted for a Qing censor in the 1740s.

main.file: A view of the north gate tower and a portion of the streets of Taipeh.jpg
main.zh: 台北城北門與城內街道。城牆 1884 年完工，照片為 1895 年日本陸地測量部所攝。
main.en: The North Gate of Taipei and the streets inside the wall, finished in 1884; photographed by the Japanese army survey in 1895.

main.file: The 5th Regiment of Japanese Army resting in near the north gate of Taipeh.jpg
main.zh: 1895 年，日軍在台北城北門附近休息。日本陸地測量部攝。
main.en: Japanese troops resting near Taipei’s North Gate in 1895; photographed by the army survey.

main.file: Opening ceremony of the Jukan Railway Line at Taichu Park.jpg
main.zh: 1908 年 10 月，縱貫鐵路全線通車典禮在台中公園舉行。
main.en: October 1908: the ceremony at Taichung Park for the completed West Coast railway.

main.file: 文化協會第一屆理事會 (cropped).jpg
main.zh: 台灣文化協會第一回理事會合影，1926 年。
main.en: The first board meeting of the Taiwan Cultural Association, 1926.

main.zh: 台北劍潭山上的臺灣神社，1933 年。皇民化時期，神社參拜成為動員的一環。
main.en: Taiwan Shrine on the hill at Jiantan, Taipei, 1933. Shrine visits became part of wartime assimilation.

main.zh: 1945 年 10 月 25 日受降典禮當天，聚集在台北公會堂外的民眾。
main.en: October 25, 1945: the crowd outside Taipei City Public Auditorium on the day of the surrender ceremony.

main.zh: 1947 年 2 月 28 日，民眾聚集在專賣局台北分局前，焚燒局內的物品。
main.en: February 28, 1947: a crowd outside the Monopoly Bureau’s Taipei branch, burning goods from the building.

main.zh: 1949 年 5 月的戒嚴令。台灣省政府與台灣省警備總司令部布告。
main.en: The martial law order of May 1949, issued by the provincial government and the Taiwan Garrison Command.

main.zh: 1987 年 7 月，總統蔣經國公布的解嚴令。
main.en: The order lifting martial law, promulgated by President Chiang Ching-kuo in July 1987.

main.zh: 1990 年 3 月，野百合學運。學生靜坐要求國會全面改選。
main.en: March 1990: the Wild Lily student movement. Students sat in to demand a fully elected legislature.

c228.zh: 黃榮燦木刻版畫《恐怖的檢查》，1947 年。畫的是 2 月 27 日天馬茶房前的緝菸衝突。
c228.en: Huang Rong-can’s woodcut The Terrible Inspection (1947), showing the cigarette raid of February 27.

c228.zh: 2 月 28 日，民眾聚集在專賣局台北分局前，焚燒局內的物品。
c228.en: February 28: a crowd outside the Monopoly Bureau’s Taipei branch, burning goods from the building.

c228.file: 二二八事件處理委員會要求陳儀承諾縣市長直接民選 Taiwanese People asked for People-elected Mayors after the 228 Incident in 1947 (cropped).png
c228.zh: 1947 年 3 月上旬的《台灣新生報》：陳儀廣播，承諾長官公署改為省政府、縣市長 7 月 1 日民選。幾天後援軍登陸。
c228.en: Taiwan Shin Sheng Daily News, early March 1947: Chen Yi’s broadcast promising a provincial government and elected mayors from July 1. Days later the troops landed.

c228.zh: 律師湯德章，3 月 13 日在台南民生綠園遭公開槍決。
c228.en: Lawyer Tang De-zhang, shot in public in Tainan on March 13.

c228.zh: 陳儀 3 月 20 日發布的《為實施清鄉告民眾書》。
c228.en: Chen Yi’s proclamation of March 20 announcing the purges.

c228.zh: 陳澄波〈夏日街景〉，1927 年，畫的是嘉義街頭。1947 年 3 月 25 日，他在嘉義車站前遭槍決。
c228.en: Chen Cheng-po, Summer Street (1927), a street in Chiayi. He was shot in front of Chiayi Station on March 25, 1947.

cwt.zh: 1949 年 5 月的戒嚴令。台灣省政府與台灣省警備總司令部布告。
cwt.en: The martial law order of May 1949, issued by the provincial government and the Taiwan Garrison Command.

cwt.zh: 台北馬場町紀念公園。1950 年代，這片河濱是槍決政治犯的刑場。
cwt.en: Machangding Memorial Park, Taipei. In the 1950s this riverbank was the execution ground for political prisoners.

cwt.zh: 綠島新生訓導處。國家人權博物館提供。
cwt.en: The New Life Correction Center on Green Island. Photo: National Human Rights Museum.

cwt.zh: 胡適與雷震，1959 年。隔年雷震因籌組反對黨入獄十年。
cwt.en: Hu Shih and Lei Chen, 1959. A year later Lei was jailed for ten years for trying to found an opposition party.

cwt.zh: 新店景美的軍法處看守所，今日的白色恐怖景美紀念園區。
cwt.en: The military detention center at Jingmei, Xindian, today a White Terror memorial park.

cwt.file: 綠洲山莊監獄 Lüdao Lodge (Oasis Villa) prison of TAIWAN.jpg
cwt.zh: 綠島的國防部感訓監獄「綠洲山莊」，1972 年啟用。
cwt.en: Oasis Villa, the Defense Ministry prison on Green Island, opened in 1972.

cwt.zh: 1987 年 7 月，總統蔣經國公布的解嚴令。
cwt.en: The order lifting martial law, promulgated by President Chiang Ching-kuo in July 1987.

cwt.zh: 鄭南榕胸像。1989 年，他為爭取百分之百的言論自由自焚。
cwt.en: A bust of Nylon Deng, who set himself on fire in 1989 for complete freedom of speech.

cwt.zh: 台北凱達格蘭大道旁的白色恐怖政治受難者紀念碑，2008 年落成。
cwt.en: The memorial to the victims of the White Terror on Ketagalan Boulevard, Taipei, unveiled in 2008.
